answers.reason: Students do not belong to the senate since it decides on the whole university and groups only take part in bodies for their own matters.
Budget planning allocates funds and is not the specific body where student matters are decided.
Appointment committees select candidates for vacant professorships, which is not a student matter.
Faculty councils decide on faculty affairs and study regulations, which directly concern students as members enrolled in degree programmes.
Examination boards decide on examination matters of individual students.
